detail.longDescription: Reboot your homelab every night without restarting anything twice A reboot fixes the kernel, and it also restarts every service you restarted an hour earlier for a library update. On my machines a service restarts at most once a night, and only the reboots a security fix needs happen. https://www. michelebologna.net/2026/reboot -every-night-restart-once/ # homelab # kubernetes # k3s # kured
